source(output(
		RECORD_TYPE as string,
		RID as string,
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT as string,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT as string,
		STATUS_MSG as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InitialPRFResponseFlatFileSource
InitialPRFResponseFlatFileSource split(substring(toString(RECORD_TYPE), toInteger(1), toInteger(1)) == 'T',substring(toString(RECORD_TYPE), toInteger(1), toInteger(1)) != 'T', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplitIgnoreFooterRow@(FOOTERROW,DATAROW,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplitIgnoreFooterRow@FOOTERROW sink(input(
		RECORD_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		RECORD_TYPE)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderRecordsetDestination
ConditionalSplitIgnoreFooterRow@DATAROW sink(input(
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT as string,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT as string,
		STATUS_MSG as string,
		RECORD_TYPE as string,
		RID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		BENEFIT_PER_EFF_DT,
		BENEFIT_PER_TERM_DT,
		STATUS_MSG,
		RECORD_TYPE,
		RID)) ~> InitialPRFResponseFileStaging
